versions.name: RXV2-0.9.393-gear-ratio-label
versions.notes: Wording: the Setup button now reads 'failsafe, battery, gear ratio' (was 'gear').

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.392-settings-moved
versions.notes: View channels is now just that - viewing channels. The gear ratio, battery voltage divider and failsafe settings have moved up to their own 'Receiver settings' page under Setup, where they belong.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.391-diag-sections
versions.notes: Tidier View-channels page: the live channel bars and the three unrelated settings (gear ratio, battery voltage divider, failsafe) are now grouped under clear 'Live channels' and 'Settings' section headings, each setting with its own subheading.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.390-tx-vbat-slow
versions.notes: The battery number on the V1 transmitter's screen now gets its own extra-slow (~7 s) averaging so it sits dead-still up there, while the phone app and the flight-log voltage trace keep the quicker, more responsive reading. Best of both.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.389-vbat-smooth
versions.notes: Steadier battery-voltage reading: the divider ADC now oversamples 32x per update (was 4x) plus a gentle 2-second smoothing, so the number sits rock-still even without the divider's filter capacitor - while still following real changes quickly enough for the flight voltage trace.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.388-tx-guard
versions.notes: Back up and Restore now refuse to run while the transmitter is ON, with a clear explanation - a backup taken under a live TX silently skipped the bank walk and saved less than everything (Malcolm's catch).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.387-nav-dedup
versions.notes: Tidier navigation (Malcolm's suggestion): the bottom 'Back to front screen' button is gone - the top-left Home button already does that job. Sub-pages keep their one-level-up Back button (e.g. WiFi back to Setup), which Home can't do.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.386-tail-label
versions.notes: Servos screen: servo 4 is now labelled TAIL servo (Rotorflight's fixed allocation: servos 1-3 swashplate, 4 tail).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.385-servos
versions.notes: NEW: Servos screen (Rotorflight menu) - each servo's centre (subtrim), travel limits, throw scale, direction, swash geometry correction, update rate and slow-motion time, read from and written to the flight controller with every save verified byte-for-byte. The crash-repair screen: swap a servo at the field, re-centre, set throws, fly.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.384-msp-wait
versions.notes: MSP wait window 400ms to 1200ms - chunked responses span several telemetry frames.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.383-msp-chunks
versions.notes: Groundwork for the Servos screen (and everything after): the receiver now reassembles chunked MSP responses from the flight controller, so replies bigger than one radio frame (like the full servo configuration) arrive intact instead of being silently dropped.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.382-fc-hint
versions.notes: Home page now hints when a flight controller is obeying but silent: 'check TELEMETRY is enabled in Rotorflight' - a fresh FC with telemetry off cannot be detected (it obeys channels but never speaks), which cost Malcolm a hunt on two new builds.
